result.title: Anthropic Is Raising Prices And Pissing People Off
result.description:
🗓️ Save these dates:

Anthropic is making massive changes to Claude’s pricing. Here is exactly what is happening and when: 

- Weekly limits for Claude Code are increasing by 50% through July 13th. That means you can send significantly more prompts and generate more code before hitting the usage cap.

- BUT starting June 15th, using Claude outside of Claude Code (like OpenClaw or Hermes) means you get a set monthly credit, and once credits run out, you are billed at the expensive API rate. Some people are estimating a 100-200 credit will burn out in just a few HOURS of heavy work, making Claude Code way more expensive for many.

Send this to anyone using Claude Code so they aren't surprised by their next bill…

#AI #Ainews #claudecode #developers #anthropic

result.title: Notion Announces Massive Update For Developers
result.description:
Notion just quietly dropped a MASSIVE update for developers.

The new Notion Developer Platform is officially here, and they just rolled out the ability to:

- Control and build with Notion directly from your terminal.
- Run your code directly on Notion’s infrastructure.
- Deploy real-time triggers for your automations.
- Allow external AI agents like OpenClaw or Hermes to build in Notion for you

Send this to a Notion power-user so they know about this update!

result.title: Viral Post Embarrassingly Exposes AI Haters 💀
result.description:
Internet art critics just took the biggest L of the year 💀

A user on X posted a REAL Monet painting, slapped an "AI Generated" tag on it, and asked people to critique it.

People wrote whole essays about how the painting was "soulless," "lacked human touch," and "obviously a computer." But they were roasting a real Monet painting...

It just goes to show that yeah, some people may hype up AI, but some people are also hype HATING on it too.

Send this to the biggest AI hater you know and see how they react...

#ai #ainews #aiart #genai

result.title: Krea AI Launches Crazy New Image Model
result.description:
How to get the PERFECT AI art style every single time:

1. Go to Krea.ai and toggle to the "Krea 2 Large" model for photorealism or "Krea 2 Medium" model for illustrations
2. Click "Mood Boards" on the bottom dashboard
3. Drop in a batch of images that share the aesthetic you want
4. Let Krea analyze the palette and mood
5. Prompt whatever you want and it will match your Mood Board perfectly

Krea V2 just dropped and it's perfect for if you’re building a brand, designing a project, or want AI to mimic your own artwork.

➡️ Share this with a creative friend and SAVE it to so you don't forget to test it out later!
